name: n4_behavior_snapshot
description: Snapshot the behaviour of the control points below scope before a module deploy, for n4_behavior_diff after it (read-only on the station). One BQL read: select slotPath, out.value, status.bits from control:ControlPoint (at most max_points rows). The result is written to <state-dir>/snapshots/<name>.json (0600, never overwritten: a taken name is refused) and the reply gives name, station, scope, taken_at, points, truncated (with truncated_note) and file. Values are kept as the station writes them (its locale included).

name.description: Snapshot name: letters, digits, '_' or '-', up to 80 (e.g. before_deploy_2026_11_16)

scope.description: Slot ORD whose control points are read

max_points.description: Most points read; beyond it the snapshot is truncated
